pairs.registryProposal: Prior verdict (rev 4) re-judged against rev 5: still a deviation. Partial backend fix (ae76c1fb8c CancelOutcome Requested/Reclaimed) shows a real-world middle state the technique lacks words for: a cancel that SIGNALLED but cannot prove the task stopped. The technique's two-step cancelling->cancelled assumes the runner can observe stop; consider naming 'requested-unconfirmed' as an honest terminal-ish state for un-abortable spans. Also: cancelWorkflowJob/getWorkflowsOverview have no UI caller in src/ - context paths may over-claim this surface.
